system_information.description: A centralized web-based platform for official university announcements, academic reminders, events, activities, and important updates.

role_record.responsibility: Manages users, staff accounts, announcements, categories, reports, and system settings.
Creates official university announcements and university events for the DOrSU community.
Creates faculty and program-related announcements under the assigned faculty.
Views announcements, events, notifications, saved announcements, and private messages.
